subject: Music Production
title: Stems and the Remix Economy
description: One-minute skill: Stems and the Remix Economy.

hook.text: AI stem separation tools can now isolate vocals, drums, and instruments from any finished song.

buildup.text: Producers who once needed official stem files can now extract individual parts from any recording.

discovery.text: This technology has created a massive wave of unofficial remixes and mashups flooding the internet.

twist.text: Labels struggle to enforce copyright when anyone can separate and resample their catalog instantly.

climax.text: Stem separation has made every existing recording a potential sample library for future producers.

punchline.text: AI can tear any song apart into its raw ingredients.

quiz.question: What can AI stem separation tools do?
options: Only work on songs with official stems released
Isolate vocals, drums, and instruments from any song
Create entirely new compositions from scratch
